items.question: Does this result fix my personality type?
items.answer: No. It is a working interpretation based on this response and should be checked against real situations and continued observation.

items.question: Can E105 and FC144 scores be compared directly?
items.answer: No. They share one Enneagram content model but use different response tasks and scoring spaces.

technical_note.title: Technical Note
technical_note.summary: Explains forms, score spaces, interpretation boundaries, data status, and privacy handling without making diagnostic, hiring, or deterministic personality claims.

disclaimers.label: Not diagnostic
disclaimers.copy: This test supports personality-pattern reflection and is not for clinical diagnosis or treatment advice.

disclaimers.label: No clinical-validity claim
disclaimers.copy: This version makes no claim of external clinical validity, accuracy, or predictive ability.

disclaimers.label: Not for hiring
disclaimers.copy: This test is not for hiring, promotion, termination, or employment screening.

disclaimers.label: No hard theory judgment
disclaimers.copy: Wing, arrow, subtype, and health level are not hard system conclusions in this version.

disclaimers.label: No cross-form numeric comparison
disclaimers.copy: E105 and FC144 share one model but use different scoring spaces and are not compared numerically by default.

disclaimers.label: Self-observation boundary
disclaimers.copy: user_confirmed_type records self-observation evidence and never silently overwrites the system primary_candidate.

share.title: My Enneagram Observation
share.summary: This is a private self-observation result; type candidates support reflection and are not fixed labels.
share.method_boundary: E105 and FC144 use different scoring spaces. Shared content does not expose raw answers or private identifiers.

clear.title: Enneagram summary | Type {primary} candidate
clear.summary: My FermatMind Enneagram result currently leans toward Type {primary}. The signal is relatively clear, but it should still be used as a framework for continued self-observation.

close_call.title: Enneagram summary | Type {primary} vs Type {secondary}
close_call.summary: My FermatMind Enneagram result suggests I may be oscillating between Type {primary} and Type {secondary}. The report keeps the distinction cautious instead of forcing a single label.

diffuse.title: Enneagram summary | diffuse profile
diffuse.summary: My FermatMind Enneagram result shows a diffuse pattern. The system suggests watching the Top 3 and the overall profile before fixing on one type.

low_quality.title: Enneagram summary | wider interpretation boundary
low_quality.summary: My FermatMind Enneagram result is readable, but the interpretation boundary is wider. It is better used as an observation cue than a final label.

pdf.title: Private Enneagram Result Report
pdf.footer: For self-observation and reflection only; not for diagnosis, ability assessment, hiring, or personnel decisions.

print.title: Printable Enneagram Result
print.footer: Printed content comes from the immutable canonical snapshot for this result.

history.title: Result History
history.summary: Historical results use the immutable content snapshot captured at completion and are not recomputed with current copy.

compare.title: Result Comparison
compare.summary: Compare only results with compatible forms and scoring spaces; E105 and FC144 values are not directly compared.
